power_case_effect_noise: Common generated base per case across all effects/candidates; no tuning from market leaves.
corrected_family: Local Bonferroni over4 two-sided horizon pvalues, Holm over3 contexts, local adjusted leaf p must also reject at allocated Holm step; no significance required from unrelated contexts. Family reference alpha.025 leaves calibration headroom to declared ceiling.05. Studentized HAC Bartlett; nominal t20 is conservative finite reference, validated envelope only, not distribution-free.
complete_lead: Adjusted significance and same selected leaf sign in >=3of4 chronological quarters, >=half6 coherent symbol mean signs. Breadth is demonstration for broad replicated cohort only, not universal six-symbol law. Extra stability gates only remove rejections. Preserve all daily scores and mask in inference.
old_reference: Exact variance-composition HAC lag2 on21 two-week means, cutoff5, same significant sign all3 contexts, all3 chronological thirds, >=4of6 assets. Uses one horizon only. Comparator on same daily synthetic score paths, not mechanical rerun of old market outcomes. Synthetic historical-calibration tables retained separately in audit.
mask_law: Missing case removes final10day block and independently5percent isolated days; do not compress calendar for HAC. Weekly means require>=3valid days, daily requires>=168. Old block requires both weeks valid with>=3days each; >=18blocks and >=5per third. Missing values not zero return; zero centered summands implement covariance mask only.
error_gate: For BOTH global and partial null (context0 horizon0 shifted1SD, all other leaves null), everycase simultaneous Wilson upper z3.4<=.05; report ungated any-null rejection, completelead and old universaldecision separately. Partial-null only counts rejection of true null leaves; no adaptive candidate or scenario removal.
power_gate: No mandatory2SD veto. Curves and grid MDE defined as smallest effect with Wilson z1.96 lower>=.8; no interpolation. Unknown/outsidegrid explicitly reported.
candidate_selection: Eligible only if all predeclared error gates pass; choose lower worst-case localized gridMDE across all8cases, ties prefer daily. No calibration failure rescue. If neither passes protocol inference remains uncertified and real responses stay blocked.
limitations: 210 eligible-day joint score vectors, not raw M5 or guaranteed independent days. Synthetic finite stress evidence cannot certify arbitrary real dependence, prefix estimation, causal feature extraction, endogenous missingness or another geometry. Every future mechanism requires exact-geometry calibration and prefix/dependence/gap model before opening.
